editorial:
Imagine getting a surprise inheritance from a dad you barely knew, only to find out it is just a dusty old bar. That is exactly what happens to Russell. At first, the movie feels like a cozy drama about a guy trying to find his place in the world and making new friends in a small town. You will really like how the atmosphere shifts from a warm, welcoming pub vibe into something much stranger and more mysterious as the story unfolds. It starts slow, but once the weird stuff begins, you will be glued to your seat wanting to know what is actually going on with the building.

The acting feels very natural, and the way the secret is revealed keeps you guessing. Some parts of the middle drag a bit, but the big twists make up for it. If you enjoy stories where a normal place turns out to be something supernatural, you should definitely check this one out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the bar. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for those crisp visuals.
endingExplained: You will find out that the bar is actually a gateway for a supernatural entity that feeds on the emotions of the patrons. Russell discovers his father didn't own the bar, but was actually its keeper. In the final scenes, Russell has to decide if he will take over his father's role to keep the entity contained. He chooses to stay, sealing the dark secret away but sacrificing his own freedom to protect the town.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family secrets and supernatural mysteries.
